detail.title: Intex FA80PBGL 8 Kg Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine (Plastic Body)
detail.overview: The Intex FA80PBGL 8 Kg Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine is designed to provide efficient and convenient laundry care for modern households. Featuring a spacious 8 Kg capacity, it is ideal for small to medium-sized families. Equipped with 10 versatile wash programs and intelligent Fuzzy Logic Technology, the machine automatically adjusts wash parameters to deliver optimal cleaning performance while protecting fabrics. Its 700 RPM spin speed helps remove excess moisture, reducing drying time. The durable Stainless Steel Inner Drum ensures long-lasting reliability and hygienic washing. Additional features such as Delay Wash, Low Water Pressure Operation, and End Program Buzzer add convenience to your daily routine. Finished in a stylish Black color, this washing machine combines advanced technology, durability, and ease of use for spotless washing results every time.
